title: Scariest haunted houses in South Florida, October 2026
igCaption:
The scariest haunted houses in South Florida this October 🎃

House of Horror: Tropical Park, 5 haunts, through Oct 31 (25th year, new home)
Horrorland: Jungle Island, 6 haunts, through Nov 1
Sounds of Screams: Fair Expo Center, 4 haunts, new this year
Nightmare Village: Xtreme Action Park, Fort Lauderdale, opens Oct 2
Fright Nights: South Florida Fairgrounds, West Palm, Thu–Sat nights from Oct 8

Which one are you brave enough to try? Tag the friend who's screaming first.

#MiamiHalloween #HauntedHouse #SouthFlorida #MiamiEvents

scenes.text: These are the scariest haunted houses in South Florida this October. Number one just moved.
scenes.caption: These are the scariest haunted houses in South Florida this October. Number one just moved.

scenes.text: House of Horror turns twenty-five this year. And it has a new home at Tropical Park. Five haunted houses, plus rides. It runs through Halloween night.
scenes.caption: House of Horror turns 25 this year. And it has a new home at Tropical Park. 5 haunted houses, plus rides. It runs through Halloween night.

scenes.text: Horrorland takes over Jungle Island. That's six haunted houses, plus scare zones and carnival games. It's open through November first.
scenes.caption: Horrorland takes over Jungle Island. That's 6 haunted houses, plus scare zones and carnival games. It's open through Nov. 1.

scenes.text: Sounds of Screams is brand new. It's at the Fair Expo Center, from the people behind Bayside Haunted Nights. Four haunted houses, through November first.
scenes.caption: Sounds of Screams is brand new. It's at the Fair Expo Center, from the people behind Bayside Haunted Nights. 4 haunted houses, through Nov. 1.

scenes.text: In Fort Lauderdale, Nightmare Village opens October second. It's indoors at Xtreme Action Park. Three different haunts.
scenes.caption: In Fort Lauderdale, Nightmare Village opens Oct. 2. It's indoors at Xtreme Action Park. 3 different haunts.

scenes.text: And up in West Palm, Fright Nights is back at the South Florida Fairgrounds. Thursday to Saturday nights, starting October eighth.
scenes.caption: And up in West Palm, Fright Nights is back at the South Florida Fairgrounds. Thursday to Saturday nights, starting Oct. 8.
